            layouts, images = [], []

                root = randlayout.gen_tree(rng, 0, len(starts), starts)

"""        for trial in range(12):
            layouts, images = [], []
            ok = True
            # share the resident budget out over the versions
            left = case["cache_pages"]
            budgets = []
            for _ in range(len(versions)):
                take = rng.randint(0, left)
                budgets.append(take)

            for (starts, hops), pv, share in zip(versions, per_version, budgets):
